The SSH daemon mimics subtle timing vulnerabilities, prolonging attacker engagement by introducing randomized authentication delays and interactive prompts. This encourages exploration of novel attack paths and timing-based exploits. The LLM plugin further sustains attacker interaction by dynamically responding to any SSH command.
